ckLanguage.description: CK language version. Omitted = 1. Version 2 enables 'interfaces' (incl. extends, association and method members, deprecated), 'implements', attribute 'access', 'methods', 'visibility', 'derivable' and association 'targetCkInterfaceId' (CK v2, AB#5584).

compatibility.description: AB#6295: decisions of the model author about the compatibility gates (ckLanguage 2). Valid for exactly this release.

acknowledge.description: Explicit acknowledgements of changes that need one (a security-sensitive access tightening, a unique index on a stable base). An entry that matches no change of this release is stale and fails the build (OCTO-CK204); a change that needs an acknowledgement and has none fails with OCTO-CK203. An acknowledgement never lowers the required version bump.

change.description: The change key exactly as the compile gate prints it (OCTO-CK203). Exact match, no wildcards.

reason.description: Why the change is accepted. Mandatory.
